newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo firms on mark, may gain further.
newsitem.headline: Escudo firms on mark, may gain further.

text.p: The escudo was firmer against the mark in early Thursday trade and could strengthen further, traders said.
Foreign buying of stock in recently-privatised EDP was one factor lifting the Portuguese currency, they said.
The escudo was trading at 100.66/71 to the mark against 100.72/75 at Wednesday's close.
"There is interest in the escudo and I would not be surprised if today or tomorrow it did not reach 100.50," said one trader.
